ns2:section.sectionText: Paris: a Multicultural Perspective: Immigration & Globalization Registration is restricted until students have been accepted into the program by the Study Abroad Office. See the following link for more information. http://www.las.uiuc.edu/students/international/coursesabroad/summer/ This course runs the second eight weeks of the spring 2011 semester. On-campus meetings begin March 14th to May 4th, 2010. Off - campus dates are mid-May to the end of May, 2011.
